name: Cracks in the Aegis: A Superheroine NTR Story
source:
Chelsea Whitmore is back in the spotlight, unaware that her return as Aegis has ignited the darkest obsessions in the city. Gus, her tech-obsessed engineer, isn't just watching her stats, he’s plotting to claim the goddess for himself while her husband, Julian, stays oblivious in the background. But Gus is just the first in line; from every dark alley to her own neighbors, a city of predators is watching, waiting for the legendary shield to crack. In this NTR journey, the hero is no longer a protector, she is the ultimate prize for every man who wants to see her fallen.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/Aleksandr14/posts/cracks-in-aegis-152737060]Patreon[/url]]

Cancelled for lack of support as well as because of the burden of developing three games at the same time.
translation:
切尔西·惠特莫尔重返聚光灯下，却浑然不知自己以女英雄“神盾”之姿复出，已点燃了整座城市最幽暗的执念。痴迷技术的工程师格斯盯着的远不只是她的各项战力数据——趁着她的丈夫朱利安在幕后毫无察觉，他正密谋将这位女神据为己有。然而格斯不过是排在最前头的那一个；从阴暗深巷到隔壁邻居，整座城市的掠食者都在暗中窥伺，只等那面传说中的坚盾出现裂痕。在这段NTR旅途中，超级英雄不再是守护者，而是每一个渴望亲眼看她堕落的男人眼中的终极战利品。

[摘自[url=https://www.patreon.com/Aleksandr14/posts/cracks-in-aegis-152737060]Patreon[/url]]

因缺乏赞助支持以及同时开发三款游戏的负担过重，本项目已取消开发。
